senses.gloss: स्थ . See p. 1262, col. 3.
स्थ mf(आ)n. (or ष्ठ) (only ifc.) standing, staying, abiding, being situated in, existing or being in or on or among (see अग्नि-, गर्भ-, जल-, नरक-, राज्य-स्थ &c.)
occupied with, engaged in, devoted to performing, practising (see ध्यान-, यज्ञ-, योग-, सवन-स्थ &c.)
a place, ground (ibc. = स्थल), L.
स्था [cf. Gk. ἱ-στάναι; Lat. stare; Lith. stóti; Slav. stati; Germ. stân, stehen; Eng. stand.]
2. स्था॑ (or ष्ठा॑), mfn. (nom. m. n. स्था॑स्) standing, stationary (often ifc. = ‘standing, being, existing in or on or among’, cf. अग्नि-ष्ठा, ऋत-स्था &c.), RV.; PañcavBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
स्थकर = स्थगर below, Kauś.
स्थग् [cf. Gk. στέγω, στέγη, τέγος, &c.; Lat. tegere, toga, tugurium; Lith. stė́gti, stógas; Germ. decken, Dach; Eng. thatch.]
स्थग mfn. cunning, sly, fraudulent, dishonest, L.
स्थाग m. (derivation doubtful) a dead body, L.
N. of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
स्थगी (ई), f. a box (for holding betel and areca-nut), L.
स्थगन n. the act of covering or hiding, concealment, Rājat.
स्थगयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be hidden or concealed, Pañcat.
स्थगर n. (also written स्थकर cf. तगर, तगरक) a partic. fragrant substance or powder, TBr.; Gobh.
स्थागर mfn. made of स्थगर, q.v., TBr.
स्थगल prob. = स्थगर. See स्थागल.
स्थागल m. or n. (?) = स्थगर (cf. स्थगल), g. किशरादि.
स्थगिका f. a kind of bandage, Suśr.
a box (for betel &c.), Hcat.
a courtezan (?), Śukas.
स्थगित mfn. covered, concealed, hidden (स्थगिता सरस्वती, ‘S˚ has hidden herself’ = ‘I cannot express myself’), Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.
closed, shut (as a door), MārkP.
stopped, interrupted, BhP.
स्थगु m. a hump on the back (v.l. स्थडु), L.
स्थगणा f. the earth, L.
स्थडु m. See स्थगु above.
स्थण्डिल n. (of unknown derivation; accord. to some connected with √ स्थल्) an open unoccupied piece of ground, bare ground (also with केवल), an open field, MBh. &c.
a piece of open ground (levelled, squared, and prepared for a sacrifice), ŚāṅkhBr.; ŚrS.
a boundary, limit, landmark, W.
a heap of clods, MW.
स्थण्डिल m. N. of a Ṛṣi, Cat.
स्थाण्डिल mfn. sleeping on the bare ground (as a penance), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 15; raised (as a toll) from a Sthaṇḍila g. शुण्डिकादि
स्थाण्डिल m. = स्थण्डिल-शायिन्, L.
स्थाण्डिल . See p. 1261, col. 3.
स्थण्डिल—श mfn. (cf. गिरि-श &c.) lying on the bare ground, L.
स्थण्डिल—शय्या f. the act of lying on the bare ground (as a penance), MBh.
स्थण्डिल—शायिका f. id., Divyāv.
स्थण्डिल—शायिन् mfn. = -श
स्थण्डिल—शायिन् m. a devotee who sleeps on the bare ground or on the sacrificial ground (on account of a vow), R.; Bhaṭṭ.
स्थण्डिल—संवेशन n. = -शय्या, BhP.
स्थण्डिल—सितक n. an altar (= वेदि), L.
स्थण्डिलक See स-स्थ्˚.
स्थण्डिले (loc. of स्थण्डिल), in comp.
स्थण्डिले—शय m. = स्थण्डिल-शायिन्, Yājñ.; BhP.
N. of a Ṛṣi, Cat.
स्थण्डिले—शयन n. = स्थण्डिल-शय्या, MBh.
स्थण्डिलेय m. N. of a son of Raudrāśva, MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.
स्थण्डिल्य w.r. for स्थण्डिल, ChUp.
स्थ-पति . See p. 1262, col. 3.

स्थ—प॑ति m. (accord. to some स्थपति, fr. caus. of √ 1. स्था) ‘place-lord’, a king, chief, governor, head official (accord. to KātyŚr., ‘a Vaiśya or even a person of lower caste, who has celebrated the Go-sava sacrifice after being chosen king’; accord. to others, ‘an Āyogava who is a town official’; cf. निषाद-स्थ्˚), AV.; VS.; Br.; ŚrS.; R.; Śiś.
an architect, master builder, carpenter, wheelwright, MBh.; R. &c. (IW. 185)
one who sacrifices to Bṛhas-pati, L.
a guard or attendant on the women's apartments, chamberlain, L.
a charioteer, W.
N. of Bṛhas-pati, L.
of Kubera, L.
स्थ—प॑ति mfn. chief, best, principal, L.
स्थपति . See स्थ-पति above.
स्थपनी f. the space between the eye-brows (v.l. स्थपणी), Suśr.
स्थापनी (ई), f. Clypea Hernandifolia, L.
स्थपुट mf(आ)n. (of unknown derivation; cf. स्थगु, स्थडु) hunchbacked, unevenly raised, rugged, rough, Hcar., KāśīKh.
being in difficult or distressed circumstances, W.
bent with pain, Mālatīm.
स्थपुट m. a hump, protuberance, an unevenly raised place, L.
स्थपुट—गत mfn. being or belonging to a hump (as flesh), Mālatīm.
being on raised places and in hollows, MW.

स्थपुटय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make rough or uneven, dig or root up, Caṇḍ.;
to raise or elevate by strewing or heaping, Āryav.
स्थपुटित mfn. made uneven &c. g. तारकादि.
स्थपुटी in comp. for स्थपुट.
स्थपुटी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make uneven, raise by strewing or heaping up, Hcar.
स्थपुटी—कृत mfn. made uneven &c., KāśīKh.
स्थल् (connected with √ 1. स्था) cl. 1. P. स्थलति, to stand firm, be firm, Dhātup. xx, 6.
स्थल् [cf. Gk. στέλλω, στόλος; Germ. stellen, still &c.; Eng. still.]
स्थल m. a chapter, section (of a book), Cat.
N. of a son of Bala, BhP.
स्थल (अम्), n. = स्थली above
dry land (opp. to damp low-land), firm earth (opp. to water), TS. &c. &c.
ground, soil, place, spot, Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.
a flat surface, roof (of a palace), Megh.
situation, circumstance, case (तथाविध-स्थले, ‘in such a case’), Sāh.; Sarvad.
a topic, subject, W.
a text, ib.
(स्थ॑ला), a heap of artificially raised earth, mound, TS.
स्थाल n. (fr. स्थल, of which it is also the Vṛddhi form in comp.) any vessel or receptacle, plate, cup, bowl, dish, caldron, pot, ŚrS.
any culinary utensil, Rājat.
the hollow of a tooth, Yājñ.
स्थाल &c. See p. 1262, col. 1.
स्थाल &c. See p. 1262, col. 1.
स्थ॑ली (ई), f. an eminence, tableland (also applied to prominent parts of the body), Lāṭy.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
soil, ground, Kālid.; BhP.
place, spot, Ragh.; Prab.
1. स्थली f. See under स्थल above.
2. स्थली in comp. for स्थल.
स्थाली (ई), f., see col. 2.
स्थाली॑ f. an earthen dish or pan, cooking-vessel, caldron, AV.; Br.; ŚrS.
a partic. vessel used in preparing Soma, MW.
the substitution of a cooked offering of rice &c. for a meat offering at the Māṃsāṣṭakā (q.v.), ib.
Bignonia Suaveolens, L.
स्थल—कन्द m. a kind of plant, L.
स्थल—कमल n. the flower of Hibiscus Mutabilis, Gīt.; Dhanv.; Bhpr.
स्थल—कमलिनी f. Hibiscus Mutabilis, Megh.
स्थल—काली f. N. of a being attending on Durgā, W.
स्थल—कुमुद m. Nerium Odorum, L.
स्थल—ग mfn. living on dry land, BhP.
स्थल—गत mfn. gone or left on dry l˚, MW.
स्थल—चर mfn. = -ग, R.; Hit.; VarBṛS.
स्थल—गामिन् mfn. id., VarBṛS.
स्थल—चारिन् mfn. id. (˚रि-ता f.), KāśīKh.
स्थल—चारि-ता f.
स्थल—च्युत mfn. fallen or removed from any place or position, MW.
स्थल—ज mfn. growing or living on dry land, Mn.; R.; Suśr. &c.
accruing from land-transport (said of certain taxes or duties), Yājñ.
स्थल—जा (आ), f. licorice-root, L.
स्थल—तर n. a higher place, Lāṭy.
स्थल—तस् ind. from dry land, MW.
स्थल—ता f. the state of being dry ground, ŚārṅgP.; Pañcat.
स्थल—देवता f. a local or rural deity, tutelary god presiding over some partic. spot, MW.
स्थल—नलिनी f. Hibiscus Mutabilis (ifc. ˚नीक mfn.), BhP.; Kād.
स्थल—नीरज n. the flower of Hib˚ Mut˚ Pañcar.
स्थल—पत्तन n. a town situated on dry land (opp. to जल-प्˚), Śīl.
स्थल—पथ m. a road by land (एन, ‘by land’), Kalpas.; Kathās. &c.
commerce by l˚, Kām., Sch.
स्थाल—पथ mfn. (fr. स्थल-प्˚) imported by land, Pāṇ. v, 1, 77, Vārtt. 3, Pat.
स्थल—पथी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to make into dry l˚ or road by l˚, Vcar.
स्थल—पद्म m. Arum Indicum, L.
the flower of Hibiscus Mutabilis, Pañcar.; Bhaṭṭ.
another plant (= छत्त्र-पत्त्र, तमालक), MW.
स्थल—पद्मिनी f. Hibiscus Mut˚ L.
स्थल—पिण्डा f. a kind of date, L.
स्थल—पुराण n. N. of wk.
स्थल—मञ्जरी f. Achyranthes Aspera, L.
स्थल—मार्ग m. a way by land, MW.
स्थल—रुहा f. Hibiscus Mutabilis, L.
स्थल—वर्त्मन् n. a road by land (˚ना, ‘by land’), Ragh.
स्थल—वर्मन् m. N. of a king, Hcar.
स्थल—विग्रह m. a land-fight, Hit.
स्थल—विहंग or स्थल—विहं˚गम, m. a land bird, BhP.
स्थल—विहंग or स्थल—विहं˚गम, m. a land bird, BhP.
स्थल—वेतस m. Calamus Rotang, Megh., Sch.
स्थल—शुद्धि f. the cleansing of any place from impurity, MW.
स्थल—शृङ्गाट or स्थल—शृङ्गा˚टक, m. Tribulus Lanuginosus or a similar plant, L.
स्थल—शृङ्गाट or स्थल—शृङ्गा˚टक, m. Tribulus Lanuginosus or a similar plant, L.
स्थल—सम्भवौषधि f. pl. plants growing on dry land, VarBṛS.
स्थल—सीमन् m. = स्थण्डिल m. (?), L.
a land-mark, boundary, W.
स्थल—स्थ mfn. standing on dry ground, MBh.; R.; BhP.
स्थलान्तर n. another place, MW.

स्थलाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become dry land, Naiṣ.

belonging to a place, local, ib.
relating or bel˚ to a situation or case (in उद्देश्य-विधेय-बोध-स्थलीय-विचार m. N. of wk.)
स्थले (loc. of स्थल), in comp.

स्थले—जात n. licorice root, L.

स्थले—शय m. ‘sleeping on dry land’, a partic. (or any) amphibious animal, L.
स्थलेयु m. N. of a son of Raudrāśva, Hariv.; VP.
स्थाल—पथिक mfn. (fr. id.) imported or travelling by land, Pāṇ.; ib., Vārtt. 1, Pat.
स्थाल—रूप n. the form or representation of a caldron or cooking-pot, MW.

स्थालिक m. the smell of faeces, L.
स्थालिक mfn. smelling of faeces, L.

स्थाली—बि˚लीय mfn. fit to be boiled in a cooking-vessel, ib., Sch.
स्थाली—बि˚ल्य mfn. fit to be boiled in a cooking-vessel, ib., Sch.
स्थाली—वृक्ष m. = -द्रुम, L.

स्थविर . See p. 1265, col. 2.

old, ancient, venerable (˚रे काले or भावे, ‘in old age’), Br. &c. &c.

(with Buddhists) an ‘Elder’ (N. of the oldest and most venerable Bhikṣus), MWB. 184; 255 &c.

स्थ॑विर (अम्), n. benzoin, L.

स्थाविर &c. See col. 3.

a kind of plant, L.

स्थवि m. (only L.) a sack, bag
heaven
a weaver
fire

fruit.

of a Prajā-pati, R.
